page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-64-lssd is a compute-optimized server instance powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9B45 processor. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this configuration delivers 64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system features 248 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 2078 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across six local drives, offering high-speed local data access without a dedicated GPU.

Benchmark results show top-tier performance across multiple compute and memory metrics. The single-core CPU performance ranks in the top 10% via stress-ng, while multi-core execution falls within the top 25%. Passmark evaluations place the CPU score, extended instructions, and memory performance in the top 10%. Additionally, the instance exhibits strong memory bandwidth, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 6717.98 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 136.56 GB/sec.

The inclusion of six local NVMe SSDs combined with top-tier database operations performance, ranking in the top 10% in Passmark database benchmarks, makes this instance highly efficient for data-intensive applications. It achieves 113.85 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 79.77 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. Furthermore, the processor's AVX-512 and vector neural network instructions support efficient small-to-medium LLM inference, processing 135M model prompts at 5440.95 tokens per second. This hardware density offers a strong qualitative performance-to-resource ratio for high-throughput databases, web serving, and localized data processing workloads.
